manifest.name: dsh-question-composer
manifest.description: Enhanced ask_user_question composer for DeepSeek Harness: batch tabs, number-key answers, and a confirm summary on top of the stock question flow

bundle.text:
# dsh-question-composer bundle patch: mount the enhanced question composer.
# `name` is the package name, resolved through the profile's node_modules.
# The client half loads immediately (platform: web) and registers the
# conversation.composer low-priority slot above the stock question surface
# (dsh-client-ui-user-questions).
- insert:
    - id: question-composer
      name: dsh-question-composer

readme.text: An enhanced `ask_user_question` composer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): batch question tabs, number-key answers, a confirm summary, and a dedicated plan-review decision card — layered on the stock question flow.

When this plugin is mounted, it **replaces** the stock `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` composer: the composer chain renders the first entry whose selector matches, so every pending `question` interaction hands the question seat to the enhanced flow. A request that declares the `plan-review` presentation intent renders its own decision surface; every other request takes the generic flow.

- **Batch tabs** — multiple pending questions render as a tab strip; answers on each tab are collected before a single batch submit.
- **Number-key answers** — `1`–`9` pick the Nth option of the visible question, `Enter` confirms.
- **Confirm summary** — the final submit shows a summary of all answers (single-choice, custom, multi-select) before sending.
- **Plan-review routing** — a question whose intent declares `plan-review` renders a decision card (approve / reject with reason) instead of the question flow.
- **Bilingual** — `zh` / `en` dictionaries on its own `question-composer` locale namespace.
- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.1.0-rc.6` (installed through the harness's package manager or a profile that resolves `@deepseek-ai/*` packages).

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-question-composer
```

The `dsh.bundle` manifest (`cordis.patch.yml`) mounts the server-side plugin entry and the `dsh.client` declaration injects the browser half immediately (`platform: web`), so a profile restart is enough to enable it.

> If you want to keep the stock composer as a fallback, keep `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` mounted too — the chain order decides which composer renders first.
(TBD — added after the first tagged release.)

```sh
npm install        # or pnpm install
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
npm run test       # vitest (jsdom-free, node environment + __ModuleLoader__ harness)
npm run build      # tsc declarations + esbuild browser bundle → lib/

- `src/client/index.ts` — client plugin body: registers the `question-composer` dictionaries and injects the composer into the `conversation.composer` slot chain (selector-routed on the `question` interaction carrier).
- `src/client/QuestionComposer.tsx` — the enhanced flow (tabs, number keys, confirm summary).
- `src/client/PlanReviewPanel.tsx` — the plan-review decision surface.
- `src/client/locales.ts` — `zh` / `en` dictionaries.
- `scripts/build.mjs` — esbuild bundle with the harness's `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` wrapper and CSS Modules compiled to an injected `<style>` tag.
- `tests/` — keyless unit tests; official client artifacts load through native-require wrappers (`tests/aliases/`) because their `__ModuleLoader__` CJS bundles shadow Node's `module` variable.

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 增强的 `ask_user_question` 问答组合器：批量问题标签页、数字键选择、提交前确认摘要，以及专用的 plan-review 决策卡片——叠加在官方问答流程之上。

挂载本插件后，它将**替换**官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions` 组合器：组合器链渲染第一个 selector 匹配的条目，因此所有待处理 `question` 交互都会进入增强流程。声明 `plan-review` 展示意图的请求渲染专属决策界面；其余请求走通用流程。

- **批量标签页** — 多个待处理问题渲染为标签条；各标签页收集答案后一次性批量提交。
- **数字键选择** — `1`–`9` 选择当前可见问题的第 N 个选项，`Enter` 确认。
- **确认摘要** — 最终提交前展示全部答案（单选、自定义、多选）摘要。
- **plan-review 路由** — 声明 `plan-review` 意图的问题渲染决策卡片（批准 / 附理由拒绝），不走问答流程。
- **双语** — 独立 `question-composer` 语言命名空间下的 `zh` / `en` 词典。
- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.1.0-rc.6`（通过 harness 的包管理器安装，或使用可解析 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包的 profile）。

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-question-composer
```

`dsh.bundle` 清单（`cordis.patch.yml`）挂载服务端插件条目，`dsh.client` 声明立即注入浏览器端（`platform: web`），重启 profile 即可生效。

> 若想保留官方组合器作为后备，可同时保留 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions`——链顺序决定哪个组合器先渲染。
（待补充——首个正式版本发布后加入。）

```sh
npm install        # 或 pnpm install
npm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit
npm run test       # vitest（无 jsdom，node 环境 + __ModuleLoader__ harness）
npm run build      # tsc 声明 + esbuild 浏览器 bundle → lib/

- `src/client/index.ts` — 客户端插件主体：注册 `question-composer` 词典，并将组合器注入 `conversation.composer` 槽链（按 `question` 交互载体路由）。
- `src/client/QuestionComposer.tsx` — 增强流程（标签页、数字键、确认摘要）。
- `src/client/PlanReviewPanel.tsx` — plan-review 决策界面。
- `src/client/locales.ts` — `zh` / `en` 词典。
- `scripts/build.mjs` — esbuild bundle：harness 的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 包装 + CSS Modules 编译为注入的 `<style>` 标签。
- `tests/` — 无密钥单元测试；官方客户端产物经 native-require 包装（`tests/aliases/`）加载——其 `__ModuleLoader__` CJS bundle 遮蔽了 Node 的 `module` 变量。
